extra_nodes.name: AI engineering
extra_nodes.description: Vynatix builds production systems on foundation models, with senior engineers embedded in the client's team: retrieval and grounded answers, evaluation pipelines, deployment into the client's environment including on-prem and sovereign cloud, and production observability.

itemOffered.name: Chatbots and assistants
itemOffered.description: Software people talk to in plain language to get an answer or get a task done.

itemOffered.name: Retrieval and grounded answers (RAG)
itemOffered.description: The system first looks up the relevant passages in your documents, and the model answers from those, citing the source.

itemOffered.name: Agent and harness engineering
itemOffered.description: An agent is a model that chooses its own next step and calls tools. The harness is the code around the model that sets what it may do and checks the result.

itemOffered.name: Workflow automation
itemOffered.description: Manual steps in a process, such as sorting, extracting details or drafting, handled by a model inside a defined flow.

itemOffered.name: MCP servers and integrations
itemOffered.description: Model Context Protocol servers that give an assistant defined, limited access to your systems and data, and connections to what you already run.

itemOffered.name: SDKs and developer tooling
itemOffered.description: Libraries and tools that let your own developers build on the system, test it and extend it.

itemOffered.name: Evaluation pipelines
itemOffered.description: Automated tests that run the system against questions with known answers, so you can see whether a change made it better or worse.

itemOffered.name: Deployment into your environment
itemOffered.description: The system runs where your data is allowed to be: in your own environment, including on-prem on your own servers or in a sovereign cloud.

itemOffered.name: Production observability
itemOffered.description: Logging and monitoring of what the system does with real questions, so errors, refusals, response times and cost are visible after launch.
